name: useStream
usage: Streaming AI replies, long-running generation with a stop button, any `text/event-stream` endpoint
signature: useStream<T, V, A extends readonly unknown[] = []>(options: UseStreamOptions<T, V, A>): StreamState<V, A>

props.name: request
props.description:
Starts the request and returns the chunks, such as `readSSE(await fetch(url, { signal }), { signal })`. Pass
`signal` on to `fetch` and the reader: it is aborted when the stream is stopped, restarted, or the component
unmounts. The arguments after `signal` are the arguments of `start`.

props.name: initial
props.description: The value before the first chunk; `start` and `reset` return to it.

props.name: reduce
props.description:
Folds a chunk into the value, such as `(text, e) => text + JSON.parse(e.data).delta`. Return a new value
instead of changing the old one. An exception fails the stream.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called with the final value when the stream finishes normally (not when it is stopped).

props.name: onError
props.description: Called when the request or `reduce` fails, with the error and the value received so far.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value accumulated so far. It is kept after the stream stops or fails.

fields.name: start
fields.description:
Starts a stream with these arguments; a stream still running is aborted first. The value starts from
`initial` again.

fields.name: stop
fields.description:
Stops the running stream: the request is aborted, the status becomes `stopped` at once and the value
received so far is kept. Does nothing when no stream is running.

fields.name: reset
fields.description: Aborts any running stream and returns to `idle` with the `initial` value.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
`request` returns the events of the response (here a simulated endpoint; in a real page, `fetch` with the same
`signal`). The text grows as events arrive; "Stop" aborts the request and keeps what has arrived.

examples.name: Failure
examples.title: Failure and retry
examples.description:
When the connection breaks, `status` becomes `error`, `error` holds the reason and the text received so far is
kept. Arguments of `start` are passed on to `request`.
